newsitem.title: MACAU: Portugal military chief discusses China-Macau issue.
newsitem.headline: Portugal military chief discusses China-Macau issue.

text.p: The chief of staff of the Portuguese armed forces, Admiral Antonio Fuzeta da Ponte, stopped over in Macau on Wednesday to discuss the territory's relations with China ahead of its return to Chinese sovereignty in 1999.
Fuzeta stopped in the Portuguese-ruled territory en route to a five-day official visit to China, beginning next Monday.
In China he is to meet Defence Minister Chi Haotian. China and Portugal have described their relations over Macau, the last of Lisbon's colonies in Asia, as very good.
Lisbon will hand Macau back on December 20, 1999, ending four and a half centuries of Portuguese rule.
Fuzeta told reporters the main topic of his talks with Portuguese Governor Vasco Rocha Vieira, an army general, would be Macau's relations with China. He did not elaborate.
